typography.notes: Existing shared font rule copied after removing its Sass comment.

icons.notes: Native Tabler calendar and arrow-left SVGs reused from the existing error page. Layout, badges, buttons and responsive behavior use native Tabler classes.

notes: Static resources can be served directly from public without Rails rendering. Sync these copies when Tabler or the shared font changes.

illustrations.method: Approved AI masters traced into editable SVG paths, with mouth, eyebrows and dashed calendar-cell outline refined manually.
illustrations.usage: Inline SVG inherits native Tabler theme variables; blue palette uses --tblr-primary. Native hide-theme utilities choose the light/dark version.
illustrations.notes: Original project illustration derived from generated images; not official Tabler artwork. Native CSS and JS remain unchanged.
